hero.subtitle: Indicative valuation based on real closing transactions, Cadastre data and the income level of each census tract. Traceable methodology for investors, agencies and analysts.

heroCard.photoAlt: Grand modernist building in Barcelona's Eixample, with a chamfered corner, domes and wrought-iron balconies

portals.title: A listing price
portals.kicker: A listing price reflects what's being asked, not what's paid. VALIO estimates market value from closed transactions and details every adjustment.

closings.title: Closing prices, not asking prices
closings.body: We work with transactions that actually closed, not the initial asking price. The gap between the two exceeds 10% in many areas.

why.title: Traceable methodology
why.body: Every adjustment —area income, condition, occupancy— is broken down with its weight on the final value. No black boxes.

honesty.title: Reliability, stated
honesty.body: With insufficient comparables, confidence drops and the range widens. Without reliable data, the system does not value.

features.title: From data to decision.
features.subtitle: Every valuation includes the full breakdown: the source and weight of each figure.

zone.title: Zone factor by census tract
zone.body: We adjust for the average income of each census tract (INE), not by postcode. The effect of location, quantified.

occupancy.title: Occupancy adjustment
occupancy.body: We estimate the discount for occupancy status —leased or irregular— to distinguish vacant value from actual value.

witnesses.title: Comparables from real transactions
witnesses.body: Comparables sourced from closings and verified feeds, with their confidence level. With fewer than six, the system does not value.

profit.title: Net after-tax yield
profit.body: It calculates the real return —transfer tax, mortgage, income tax and costs included— and the maximum purchase price for your target yield.

barrio.title: Barcelona, street by street.
barrio.kicker: Eixample facades, city rooftops and neighbourhood boulevards: the real market behind every valuation.

pricing.title: Public pricing, no surprises.
pricing.subtitle: No lock-in and no sales calls to see the rates.

official.a: No. VALIO provides indicative, technical valuations. They do not replace the official appraisal of a firm authorised by the Bank of Spain (Order ECO/805/2003).

coverage.q: Which areas do you currently cover?
coverage.a: Barcelona and its province, expanding progressively across the rest of Catalonia and Spain.

data.q: Where does the data come from?
data.a: INE (income by census tract), the Cadastre and comparables from real transactions.

leadgen.q: Do you ask for personal details or a phone number?
leadgen.a: No. We don't ask for your phone or share your data with third parties.

footer.disclaimer: VALIO provides indicative, technical valuations based on comparables and public data. They do not constitute an official appraisal nor replace the report of a valuation firm authorised by the Bank of Spain (Order ECO/805/2003). Results are estimates and are not binding.
